description: Structure-ablated, fluency-matched control. The same system with commitment continuity, Essence, repair-under-challenge, and constitution-admission disabled. Surface engine unchanged — fluency is preserved, subject-structure is removed.

disabled_features.mechanism: shouldCommit always returns Nothing; no EssenceCommitted state reached
CTS-42 admission bypassed: all claims admitted as canonical (CsaAdmitAll, no quarantine)
Challenge/ConfrontQ/MisunderstandingReport routed to generic response, not repair path
Semantic.Content predicates not appended to surface (covered topics get template-only output)

preserved_features: Turn pipeline structure (Prepare → Route → Render → Finalize)
fluency_matching_rationale: Control-A uses the identical surface engine as System. The only difference is the removal of subject-structure (Essence, admission, repair, content predicates). This isolates whether subject-structure produces a perceptible difference, holding fluency constant.
